text: Tabitii soktirgal kala huunde, ko juuɗe Alla woni: Kala ko Alla udditani yimɓe ɓen, immorde e arsike e peewal e malal, haray alaa haɗoowo ɗum; kala kadi ko O jogitii e ɗum, hay gooto hattanaa accitugol ɓaawo O jogitaade. Ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun, e kattal Mun e toppitagol Mun.
